question: In a certain code language, 'LIFETIME' is written as 'FGJMFNJU' and 'INTEGRAL' is written as 'FUOJMBSH'. How will 'INTEREST' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f14f526a98851514c15eb3e884ee034741c8435d4c221f96e6ef303c053c4509.png] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5afb7a46abcc25b0bdebf8ceed0f53a11dec70c8818071e121fc1b6a9ba556cb.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c34fa1b354b77fc6ee9830ba7438f76b4db0afb79cc3a275ac1092e519d3353f.png] 

Hence, '**FUOJUTFS**' is the correct answer.
